== Notes ==
* Each of Volley's arrows counts as a separate attack.
* Effects that trigger on attack/hit usually trigger multiple times, although some take effect only once or not at all.{{verify|Which effects take effect only once (and are not limited to one hit anyway) and which ones do not affect Volley at all?}} 
{{Bug|Volley also removes [[Glyphs]]. [[Hero behavior|Hero AI]] can use Volley right after a glyph, which removes its effect.}}
